simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַחֲלַי (H305) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: inj.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַחֲלַי (ʼachălay) means would that! First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 5 3.

definitions.full: H305. achalay אַחְלַי Psa 119:5 and אַחֲלֵי 2Kin 5:3 (perhaps from אָח III. and לַי = Aramaic לְוַי = ׃לוּ the varying punctuation is due doubtless to the word being treated by the punctuators as a substantive = wish , with suffix & in construct stative, 'my wish is that,' etc.; compare Ki on Psalm 119 וּבַקָּשׁוֺתַי תְּחִנּוֺתַי ), ah that! ( ᵐ5 ο[φελον ).
definitions.rootNote: or אַחֲלֵי ; prob from 253 and a variation of 3863 ;
